scope: 10 additional named host families; surface variants remain explicit

hosts.name: Aider

instructions.mechanism: Explicit --read or /read of convention Markdown; read config key persists selection.
instructions.precedence: Home then git root then cwd; later config wins. --config selects one file.

hosts.format: Plain Markdown convention input; no inspected native SKILL.md schema.
hosts.extensions: No plugin/hook/subagent compatibility established by these sources.
limitations: Aider is not AiderDesk. skills@1.5.25 has aider-desk but no aider adapter.
Loading Markdown explicitly does not establish skill autodiscovery or automatic AGENTS.md loading.

hosts.name: Continue
hosts.skill_precedence: CLI source collects candidates asynchronously; no same-name resolution guarantee established.

instructions.ordering: Rules lexicographical then concatenated in toolbar order; apply in Agent/Chat/Edit, not autocomplete/apply.

hosts.format: Required nonempty name and description; CLI exposes sanitized /skill-<name>.
hosts.extensions: IDE and CLI loaders are different implementations; no foreign hook or frontmatter semantics inferred.
limitations: Pinned official source 5522c6f44ca0ac3528b37244818fbfa39b5af470; not an installed version check.

Exact source helper reproduces mixed-target installer symlink loss: single Continue copy discovers1, mixed Continue+Codex symlink discovers0, mixed --copy discovers1. See continue-loader-repro.json; full native/model acceptance NOT_RUN.

hosts.name: Qwen Code
hosts.skill_precedence: Exact same-name project/user priority not established by inspected page; extension skills namespaced.

project: QWEN.md in cwd/ancestors to git root or home
instructions.precedence: More specific context supplements or overrides general; /memory exposes assembled context.

hosts.format: Nonempty name/description; Unicode names allowed; priority affects skill-list ordering only. Optional paths gates model visibility.
hosts.extensions: Manual /<registered-name>; extensions prefix owner:name. A skill-only directory does not register extensions.
limitations: Pinned installer uses default home .qwen; QWEN_HOME overrides require separate destination verification.
Safe/trusted workspace and disabled-skill settings constrain availability.

hosts.name: Google Antigravity (2.0 / IDE / CLI)

instructions.precedence: Directory-scoped instructions become more specific; modular rules require valid trigger frontmatter.

hosts.format: Directory SKILL.md; manual slash invocation and relevance-based activation.
hosts.extensions: Plugin skills require native registration; do not equate IDE, 2.0 and CLI surfaces.
limitations: Installer antigravity root is documented legacy IDE support, not proof of 2.0 current root acceptance.

hosts.name: Warp

instructions.global: Personal/team rules managed in Warp Drive; no global instruction-file path inferred.

hosts.format: Named directory containing SKILL.md with name/description and relative supporting resources.
hosts.extensions: Cloud/factory skills are scoped to their environment; local home discovery does not prove cloud availability.
limitations: All supported root names are scanned; alias presence does not determine same-name precedence.

hosts.name: Augment / Auggie CLI
hosts.skill_precedence: Highest first: user .augment > workspace .augment > user .claude > workspace .claude > user .agents > workspace .agents.

instructions.precedence: --rules then CLAUDE.md then AGENTS.md then workspace guidelines/rules then user rules; hierarchical AGENTS/CLAUDE added by file scope.

hosts.format: name 1–64 lowercase alphanumeric/hyphen, directory matching; description 1–1024.
hosts.extensions: Direct /<directory-name>; built-in command collisions win. CLI manual rules skipped; user rules always apply.
limitations: Auggie-specific evidence; do not automatically transfer every extension behavior to IDE clients.

hosts.name: JetBrains Junie
hosts.skill_precedence: Project .junie overrides user .junie; other alias/candidate priorities not established.
hosts.format: name required; description may fall back to first body paragraph. Keep explicit description for portability.
hosts.extensions: CLI /<skill> and $<skill>; disabling excludes automatic/manual selection. --skill-default-locations false disables native/shared default roots.
limitations: Other-host skill detection/import suggestions are not automatic native loading of every foreign root.
Skills supported in CLI and JetBrains IDE; loader details here are specifically documented for CLI.

hosts.name: TRAE international / CN
hosts.format: CN documents directory SKILL.md with name/description YAML; optional scripts/resources.
hosts.extensions: CN skills distinct from MCP tools; native catalog enable/disable is separate from a filesystem copy.
limitations: International official page returned no extractable body; do not promote upstream ~/.trae installer destination to native acceptance.
Regional builds and cloud/local scopes must be distinguished.

hosts.name: OpenHands
hosts.skill_precedence: Project > user > public; .agents wins legacy within scope. Explicit SDK skills override automatic user/public, but project wins same-name.

instructions.global: User/organization context depends on selected surface and enabled loaders.

hosts.format: Portable name/description; optional triggers inject matching messages; paths takes priority and turns skill into a nonadvertised file rule.
hosts.extensions: Canvas, SDK/agent server and Cloud enablement differ; explicit catalog allowlists may restrict skills.
limitations: Global public registry is not synonymous with local home root.
Legacy .md without trigger is always loaded; avoid confusing that with progressive SKILL.md loading.

hosts.name: Mistral Vibe Code
hosts.skill_precedence: Discovery order custom paths > trusted project > user.

project: nearest AGENTS.md walking ancestors within trusted folders
scoped subdirectory AGENTS discovered on file reads

hosts.format: Agent Skills; user-invocable exposes slash command; allowed-tools restricts tool set.
hosts.extensions: Custom agent/subagent TOML separate; task tool delegates, subagents cannot ask questions.
limitations: Do not import Claude allowed-tools preapproval semantics into Vibe restrictive semantics.
Vibe Code is not Vibe Work; shared standard does not imply shared installation lifecycle.
